coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: Closed-end credit fund subscription agreement: the investor completes sections 1-10 (pages 1-13), initials representations 1-8 in the primary investor column (pages 8 and 10) and signs on page 9 of the form (sheet page 14); up to two co-investors initial and sign beside them; a custodian completes and signs section 3 on custodial accounts; the financial advisor completes and signs section 11 (page 15). No issuer acceptance block.
